item.title: why can't I add geom_line()?
item.description:
Im trying to do an very simple plot, but I can't add geom\_line().
This is the code I used:
`estudios %>%`
`arrange(fecha) %>%`
`ggplot(aes(x = fecha,`
`y = col)) +`
`geom_line(size = 1) +`
`geom_point(size = 2) +`
`labs(x = "Fecha",`
`y = "Valor") +`
`theme_minimal() +`
`theme(legend.title = element_blank())`
This is my plot
https://preview.redd.it/qymst3444oxe1.png?width=1040&format=png&auto=webp&s=edba9bb81587ded756cbee06635be9b96aaa4e51
And this is what R tells me
geom_line()`: Each group consists of only one observation. ℹ Do you need to adjust the group aesthetic?
>
